codex.mcanomalyarchives.title: The Archive
codex.mcanomalyarchives.locked_hint: Not yet deciphered. It is recorded automatically once you encounter it.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.planned: This anomaly is not implemented in the mod yet; the file is incomplete.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo001.name: Fake Cloud
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo001.info: A high-altitude anomaly shaped like a vanilla cloud. Three types - Ghost, Polymorph and Displaced - and it escapes through blocks. Its grey-blue fluid makes things phase out.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo001.trait: Glass cages cannot hold it · Animals inside suffocate · Water and lava stain grey-blue · Black individuals erase nearby blocks on contact
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo002.name: The Village That Isn't
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo002.info: An inverted-colour village that only exists inside a specific rectangle of coordinates. Its villagers keep staring at you.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo002.trait: Invisible from outside the zone · Inverted colours, wrong materials · Villagers have no recognisable face · Trespassers turn inverted · The 「disaster」 traded from them makes the buyer vanish
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo003.name: Corn Poppy
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo003.info: A poppy that makes you addicted to watching it. Look straight at it and you weep for no reason; onlookers have died.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo003.trait: Affects a 128-block diameter · Viewing through cameras blocks the effect · New instances grow from the faces of dead watchers
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo004.name: Dimensional Fishing Rod
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo004.info: Looks like an ordinary rod, yet it can pull things from outside the Overworld ashore.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo004.trait: Durability cap around 8.98x10^17, one point per cast · The further you cast, the stranger the catch · Catches are inedible or dangerous · A black fisherman's shadow keeps appearing nearby
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo005.name: Purple Monster
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo005.info: A purple one-eyed humanoid in deep woods. It talks inside your head, pushes you toward negative options, and slowly assimilates you.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo005.trait: Its face is replaced by a single eye · Speaks mentally through an option window · Those who choose negative options turn purple · It vanishes in disgust when watched · Grows tendrils that impale
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo006.name: The Ore Cave
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo006.info: A bottomless, layered cave in the forest. The deeper you go the richer the ore - greed keeps you digging.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo006.trait: Six stages, from I Glimmer to VI Black Hole · Absurd veins, up to 822 iron in one · Attached anomalies: enriched ore, white miner ghosts, the thing you seek, the visionary golden gate · Old diggings vanish and the layout resets · Treasure taken out turns to ash
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo007.name: Negative Items
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo007.info: A set of inverted-colour drops with negative stack counts, anti-properties and a retroactive effect.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo007.trait: Counts are negative, colours inverted · A negative apple lowers hunger and multiplies · A negative pickaxe gains durability and randomises blocks · Negative leggings cannot be removed and summon negative entities · Replaced blocks reappear in a nearby cave
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo008.name: Shapeshifting Name Tag
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo008.info: A dark brown anomalous name tag recovered from a minecart cache inside a mineshaft. It inverts the causality of naming: a thing is not named after its properties - its properties are rewritten to match the name.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo008.trait: Changes the core, never the shell - Items and blocks must be named through an anvil - Naming is irreversible; ordinary name tags cannot overwrite it - A named creature slowly becomes the thing its name points to - Item conversion obeys material conservation and pays any deficit with an explosion - The number of extant tags is [DATA EXPUNGED]
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo009.name: The False Sun
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo009.info: A higher-dimensional projected body, visible only to the mentally ill. It anchors to reality through gaze and magnifies the watcher's desire.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo009.trait: Visible only to the mentally ill · Anchors to reality by being watched; focus sharpens it · Magnifies inner desire, then brings calm · Its form follows the watcher's illness · Can rewrite collective perception
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo010.name: Dimensional Spyglass
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo010.info: A grey telescope whose five dials let you see into other dimensions. Some images carry memetic contamination.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo010.trait: A grey telescope whose material much resembles UO-004 · Five dials α to ε below; δ and ε are broken · α shifts deviation from reality, β time, γ image density · Some images carry dangerous memetics causing extreme fear · A second viewing by the same person causes blindness
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo011.name: Strange Tree
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo011.info: A black tree that burrows and lies in wait, then kills whoever fells trees nearby. Bedrock can trap it.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo011.trait: Trunk is near-bedrock hard · Leaves near-obsidian, regrowing instantly · After 7 to 9 trees felled it uproots and burrows · Approaches underground at about 3.1 m/s and cuts with scythe-like branches · Replanting one sapling per tree prevents it
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo012.name: Lucky Pink Sheep
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo012.info: A pink sheep standing quietly in the plains. Looking at it brings luck; stare too long and it vanishes between two blinks.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo012.trait: Appears only in plains and similar open temperate biomes · Two seconds of sighting grants luck · Forty-five seconds of staring makes it blink away and relocate · Getting close or attacking triggers three tiers of calamity · The top tier gives no warning at all
